simpleJp: 6/2 強制：募兵舎で初期面接を済ませる
enGuide: 6/2 強制; Prologue first application/initial-stat choice; this is a forced plot sequence, not a discretionary social slot. Pick any desired opening stat; the selected answer affects early stats rather than future social-link viability.

simpleJp: 6/3〜6/4 強制：砦までの物語を進める
enGuide: 6/3〜6/4 強制; Advance through the opening Northern Border Fort sequence. There are no regular day/night activities to optimize in this prologue window.

simpleJp: 6/5 取り逃し注意：山林の野営地で黄金蟲を拾う
jpGuide2: 山林の野営地で黄金蟲
enGuide: Gold Beetle #1 of 50: June 5 camp tree west of fire, before sleeping; area becomes inaccessible after plot. 6/5 取り逃し注意; TRUE MISSABLE: while camping in the prologue forest, check by the tree for a Gold Beetle before leaving the forest. The prologue area does not remain accessible for ordinary return visits.

simpleJp: 6/6〜6/9 強制：ノルド廃鉱山を進み、ドラゴンを倒す
jpGuide2: ドラゴンを倒して武器
enGuide: 6/6〜6/9 強制; Story-bound mining route. Defeating the optional dragon rewards the unique Dragon Greatsword; secure it before exiting the mine. Continue until Grand Trad and the inn story, which advances fixed calendar days.

simpleJp: 6/6 強制：6/6の物語を進め、ストロールの支援ランク1を解放する
enGuide: Calendar 6/6 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Strohl R1: Automatic story recruitment in Grand Trad on 6/6; Warrior lineage unlocks.

simpleJp: 6/6 強制：6月上旬、モアの支援ランク1を確認する
enGuide: Calendar 6/6 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). More R1: Automatically opens in Akademia during the opening story (around June 5–6). Follow the introductory Archetype/tutorial quest. This has no ordinary calendar bond appointment.

simpleJp: 6/10 強制：6月上旬、マリアの支援ランク1を確認する
enGuide: Calendar 6/10 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Maria R1: Opens automatically through the Grand Trad/Hushed Honeybee Inn story (around 6/10–12). She is at Fabienne's inn; later meetings occur during the day.

simpleJp: 6/11 強制：6/11の物語でヒュルケンベルグの支援ランク1を解放する
enGuide: Calendar 6/11 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Hulkenberg R1: Automatic on 6/11 with the initial Knight unlock.

simpleJp: 6/11 強制：6/6の物語を進め、ガリカの支援ランク1を解放する
enGuide: Calendar 6/11 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Gallica R1: Automatic during the opening main story on 6/6. Her entire bond is story-driven; do not schedule meetings.

simpleJp: 6/11 強制：6/11の物語でガリカの支援ランク2を確認する
enGuide: Calendar 6/11 強制 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Gallica R2: Automatic after the 6/11 story boss; no time slot needed.

simpleJp: 6/11 事前確認：次の大聖堂作戦を始める前に保存する
enGuide: 6/11 事前確認; Advance the funeral/main-story events. The upcoming Regalith Grand Cathedral deadline is June 21; ensure Catherina's in-dungeon rescue is done during the cathedral visit. Save normally at a functioning save spot; this is recommended safety, not a source-documented save slot.

simpleJp: 6/12 昼：王都の期限依頼を受け、中央通りのベンチで見識を育てる
jpGuide2: 中央通りのベンチで過ごす
enGuide: 6/12 昼; In Grand Trad, accept available beginner errands, including bringing medicine to the pagan parent and the Hushed Honeybee Inn request; use the plaza bench for Wisdom. These errands and the inn helper route make Wisdom 2 available for Brigitta.

simpleJp: 6/12 夜：蜜蜂のささやき亭でファビアンヌの調理を手伝う
jpGuide1: ファビアンヌの料理を手伝う
enGuide: 6/12 夜; Evening virtue: help Fabienne cook at Hushed Honeybee Inn to build Tolerance. This consumes the night slot. Use the in-game recipe hints, not arbitrary choice guessing.

simpleJp: 6/12 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲2：王都の日陰通り、防具屋の北東の階段裏
enGuide: Gold Beetle #2 of 50 — Grand Trad Sunshade Row: behind the stairs northeast of the armor shop. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 6/12 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲3：王国軍募兵舎で受付左の通路を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #3 of 50 — Grand Trad Royal Army Recruitment Center: turn left from the desk toward the barracks hall. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 6/12 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲4：王都あんしん薬方堂入口の香辛料袋を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #4 of 50 — Grand Trad Anshin Apothecary: interact with the spice sack near the entrance; there is a different beetle behind the counter later. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 6/12 【町の用事】依頼『異教徒の親子に薬を届けろ』を受ける
enGuide: 6/12 町の用事. Find the pagan parent in Grand Trad, acquire the requested medicine, and plan a time-free hand-in no later than 6/16.

simpleJp: 6/13 【報告・受注・時間なし】依頼を報告し、ベレーガ回廊への依頼を受ける
jpGuide1: 輸送路の怪物を倒せ 受注
jpGuide2: ベルギッタの依頼を受注
enGuide: 6/13, no-time quest hand-in/acceptance only: report the completed Grand Trad errands after reaching Wisdom 2, and accept Brigitta's '輸送路の怪物を倒せ'. This is NOT a separate daytime activity; the one daytime dungeon slot is Regalith Grand Cathedral in the next step. Belega Corridor requires a separate later trip before the June 21 deadline.

simpleJp: 6/13 昼・攻略：レガリス大聖堂を攻略し、キャゼリナの依頼も終える
jpGuide1: レガリス大聖堂を攻略
enGuide: 6/13 昼・攻略; Complete the cathedral in one visit if resources allow (a Mage can restore MP through overworld kills). Interact with Catherina, locate and free the trapped friend, and report the rescue before leaving. Search side rooms and containers for Gold Beetles. If unable to finish in one day, use the next spare day, shifting flexible bonds rather than letting June 21 expire.

simpleJp: 6/13 大聖堂：レガリス大聖堂でキャゼリナの依頼を受けて達成する
jpGuide1: 閉じ込められた友人を探せ
jpGuide2: 閉じ込められた友人を探せ
enGuide: Calendar 6/13 大聖堂 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Catherina R1: In Regalith Grand Cathedral, accept 'Find the Trapped Friend' (閉じ込められた友人を探せ) and rescue her imprisoned friend; report completion to establish Catherina's Brawler bond. Do this on the cathedral visit before advancing past the opportunity.

simpleJp: 6/13 達成時：ヒーラーをランク10にしてアカデメイアのモアに報告する
jpGuide1: ヒーラーをランク10にする。
jpGuide2: ヒーラー」をランク10にする
enGuide: Calendar 6/13 達成時 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). More R2: Study the Healer Archetype, raise its Archetype rank to 10, then turn in More's Prologue Trial inside Akademia. This is a quest rank-up, not a regular calendar meeting.

simpleJp: 6/13 【受注・時間なし】王都募兵舎で『野犬を従える人食い怪物』を受注する
enGuide: 6/13, 受注・時間なし: From any Royal Army Recruitment Center, pick up the bounty before Tradia Desert (June 14). Defeat the target in the desert and report the bounty during your next Grand Trad visit to collect Courage rewards. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 6/14 昼：賞金首を受注してトラディア砂漠へ向かう
enGuide: 6/14 昼; Take the available desert bounty in Grand Trad and clear the Tradia Desert encounter. Turn-in can be done on the next town visit without a separate free-time action.

simpleJp: 6/14 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲6：トラディア砂漠北東の旅人の墓場を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #6 of 50 — Tradia Desert: northeast of Traveler's Graveyard, close to rocks and brush. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 6/15 昼：ベレーガ回廊を攻略して輸送路の魔物を倒す
enGuide: 6/15 昼; Travel into Belega Corridor to defeat Brigitta's quest target. Explore B3 for its Gold Beetle and pick up dungeon loot. Return and make sure the quest is ready to report on June 16.

simpleJp: 6/15 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲5：ベレーガ回廊地下2階で鉄格子前を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #5 of 50 — Belega Corridor B2: cross the gap in a wall to the chamber with two chests; collect by the iron bars. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 6/16 昼・報告：見識2で受注済みの『輸送路の怪物を倒せ』をベルギッタに報告し、支援ランク1を解放する
jpGuide1: 輸送路の怪物を倒せ クリア
jpGuide2: 依頼「輸送路の怪物を倒せ」を報告
enGuide: 6/16 昼; Return to Brigitta in Grand Trad, completing the transport-monster request and unlocking Merchant / her first bond. This hand-in is the important point, not simply winning the boss battle. This is the sole hand-in after the June 15 dungeon; do not re-accept or re-clear the same request.

simpleJp: 6/16 夜：蜜蜂のささやき亭で調理を手伝う
jpGuide1: ファビアンヌの料理を手伝う
enGuide: 6/16 夜; Tolerance practice after Brigitta's daytime hand-in; a bond is not yet eligible the same evening if its cooldown has not elapsed.

simpleJp: 6/16 【期限・報告】『異教徒の親子に薬を届けろ』を報告する
enGuide: 6/16 期限・報告. TIME-LIMITED; complete the medicine delivery and report no later than June 16, before moving to the next Follower milestone.

simpleJp: 6/17 昼：レガリス大聖堂を攻略後、昼にストロールと話す
jpGuide1: レガリス大聖堂のクリア後に会話
enGuide: Calendar 6/17 昼 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Strohl R2: From June 12, after clearing Regalith Grand Cathedral, find him at Sunlumeo Street, Grand Trad, in the daytime. Clearing the main dungeon early avoids the pre-deadline bond lockout.

simpleJp: 6/17 夜：蜜蜂のささやき亭で包容力を上げる
enGuide: 6/17 夜; Use the night for the inn helper Tolerance activity to prepare Maria R2.

simpleJp: 6/18 昼：レガリス大聖堂を攻略後、昼にヒュルケンベルグと話す
jpGuide1: レガリス大聖堂のクリア後に会話
enGuide: Calendar 6/18 昼 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Hulkenberg R2: After the cathedral, find her during the day at the Hushed Honeybee Inn (蜜蜂のささやき亭), Grand Trad. She has travel-only later ranks.

simpleJp: 6/18 夜：2日後の夜、王都でベルギッタと話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/18 夜 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Brigitta R2: At least two calendar days after handing in the Belega Corridor quest, return at night to Sunlumeo Street in Grand Trad and talk to her; do later ranks on alternating evenings.

simpleJp: 6/18 【期限・報告】『ささやき亭の手伝いをしろ』を報告する
enGuide: 6/18 期限・報告. TIME-LIMITED; finish the tavern helping quest and report it by June 19. This is distinct from the post-Maria-R2 co-helper trophy.

simpleJp: 6/19 昼：ストロールのランク2から2日後、昼に話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/19 昼 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Strohl R3: In the daytime at Sunlumeo Street, Grand Trad; wait roughly two calendar days after his R2. This should be cleared before longer trips if possible.

simpleJp: 6/19 夜：蜜蜂のささやき亭で包容力を上げる
enGuide: 6/19 夜; Continue Tolerance practice. In the selected route Tolerance reaches rank 2 at roughly this point, enabling Maria's next meeting.

simpleJp: 6/20 昼：王都の仮面の男と話して包容力を鍛える
enGuide: 6/20 昼; Use daytime conversation with the masked man for Tolerance, then return to the city in time for Brigitta at night.

simpleJp: 6/20 夜：ベルギッタのランク2から2日後、夜に再度話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/20 夜 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Brigitta R3: Night, same Grand Trad shop/street, two days after R2. If the meeting is unavailable, use the evening for Royal Virtues or another Follower.

simpleJp: 6/21 昼：街の老人に話しかけて想像力を上げる
jpGuide2: おしゃべりな老人と会話
enGuide: 6/21 昼; Speak to the talkative old man for Imagination. If the cathedral is unfinished, it must be prioritized over this discretionary activity: the June 21 deadline takes precedence.

simpleJp: 6/21 夜：蜜蜂のささやき亭で包容力を鍛える
enGuide: 6/21 夜; Use the evening to keep Tolerance on schedule for Maria; this is a swappable activity rather than a locked quest.

simpleJp: 6/22〜6/23 物語：作戦後の移動を進める
enGuide: 6/22〜6/23 物語; Story/calendar transition: continue plot events. Do not assume either date offers two unrestricted city slots; start your Runner routine once travel access is granted.

simpleJp: 6/24 昼・鎧戦車：食料庫を調べ、『新世界旅行記』を読む（1回目）
enGuide: 6/24 daytime Runner: check pantry supplies without consuming another time slot, then read 『新世界旅行記』 (first reading) during the daytime travel activity.

simpleJp: 6/24 夜・鎧戦車：焚火を調べ、『新世界旅行記』を読む（2回目）
enGuide: 6/24 nighttime Runner/camp: inspect the campfire if available and read 『新世界旅行記』 (second reading). This is the nighttime commitment, not another daytime activity.

simpleJp: 6/25 昼・鎧戦車：『新世界旅行記』を読了する（3回目）
enGuide: 6/25 daytime Runner: finish 『新世界旅行記』 (third reading). Check free amenities when available; do not count them as separate time-consuming activities.

simpleJp: 6/26 自動受注：ニューラスのコメロ村遺物依頼を受ける（回収・報告は後日）
jpGuide2: 6/26に依頼発生、コメロ村へは6/29以降
enGuide: June 26: Neuras's Komero glass-ornament/journal quest becomes available automatically. Do NOT travel to Komero or claim Neuras R1/Gunner here: Komero must first be revealed by the Martira pigeon-egg quest (available June 29 onward) or another documented unlock. The integrated route currently plans the Komero visit for July 9; complete the relic hand-in then, after verifying actual travel and time-slot feasibility. Japanese evidence: Altema Neuras, GameWith Neuras quest, Game8 Neuras R1, Gamers High relic quest.

simpleJp: 6/27〜6/28 移動・物語：マルティラへの進行を確認し、期限のある依頼を先に片づける
enGuide: 6/27〜6/28 移動・物語; Advance required story travel. If any free slot exists, favor unfinished Wisdom/Tolerance/book work; a blank date in this template does not imply two discretionary actions. Ensure Martira and the Great Sandworm's Nest trip are available for Catherina R2 after arrival.

simpleJp: 6/29 昼：6/29以降、包容力2でファビアンヌと話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/29 昼 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Maria R2: Reach Tolerance (包容力) 2. Back at Hushed Honeybee Inn in Grand Trad, speak to Fabienne as prompted and continue Maria's daytime bond. Scenic paintings are optional bonuses, not a prerequisite for ranking.

simpleJp: 6/29以降【受注・時間なし】マルティラ街道広場で伝書鳩の卵の依頼を受ける
enGuide: From June 29, accept the pigeon-egg request at Martira Thoroughfare Square (街道広場), NOT in Grand Trad. Accept it when in Martira; do not assume a free transfer from Grand Trad or spend an extra calendar activity solely to accept it. Buy the eggs at Komero on July 9 and report to the Martira giver by July 11 (the route schedules July 10). Japanese quest-location checks: Altema subquest19 and GameWith 467309.

simpleJp: 6/29 【受注・時間なし】王都の募兵舎で別の依頼・賞金首を確認する
enGuide: Grand Trad / 王都 only: check and accept separately available bounties or requests at the recruitment centre before departure; this is NOT the Martira pigeon-egg request. Accept/report interactions are no-time only when the game permits; traveling between cities is not assumed free. The Goborn bounty is listed separately in the next step.

simpleJp: 6/29 【受注・時間なし】募兵舎で『小鬼を率いる新たな王』を受注する
enGuide: 6/29, 受注・時間なし: Pick up the Goborn/Goblin Nest bounty at Martira or another recruitment centre. Kill the ruler during June 30 cave trip, then report at a recruitment centre on July 1. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 6/29 夜：ベルギッタのランク3から2日後、夜に再度話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/29 夜 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Brigitta R4: Night, Grand Trad Sunlumeo Street, two days after R3. Rank 5 will require Courage 3, so train it in spare slots.

simpleJp: 6/30 昼・移動：小鬼の巣窟への旅を進める
enGuide: 6/30 昼・移動; Take a discretionary Runner trip to the Goborn/Goblin Nest; search thoroughly for its missable Gold Beetle, and combine it with available travel-only bonds. Arrival/encounter may consume the daylight slot.

simpleJp: 6/30 鎧戦車・昼：6/29以降の任意移動中、鎧戦車のヒュルケンベルグと話す
enGuide: Calendar 6/30 鎧戦車・昼 (recommended flexible slot; satisfy game map icon and gate first). Hulkenberg R3: During discretionary travel in the Runner, find Hulkenberg on the deck in the daytime. Arrange a side-quest trip if you otherwise have no travel days.

simpleJp: 6/30 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲9：小鬼の巣窟の北西側の壁沿いを調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #9 of 50 — Goblin Nest: gather glowing spot beside the northwest wall. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.
